summary.root_cause_text: payment_provider_url was changed by ops to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable, so every payment failed silently (logged only at DEBUG) while orders were marked processed.
recommended: Confirm the payments-v2 endpoint address and readiness before retrying the migration.
Alert on payment provider failures, which are currently logged only at DEBUG.

events.text:
version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
Revert the provider URL to v1.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: payment_provider_url was changed by ops to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable, so every payment failed silently (logged only at DEBUG) while orders were marked processed.
evidence: recent_changes: config payment_provider_url payments-v1 -> payments-v2 by ops at 13:19:13
DEBUG payment: provider call failed: payment provider unreachable at internal://payments-v2
payment_gap: 13 of 27 orders processed without payment; the gap kept growing as orders arrived
args.impact: 13 of 27 orders were unpaid at alert time, and the count kept growing. money_impact at alert time: unpaid_orders SAR 2457.56 + USD 1110.62, total_sar 6622.39. After the fix, reprocess_orders paid 35 orders with none failed. It reported money_recovered total_sar 20378.18 (SAR 6364.06, USD 3737.1).
recommended_actions: Confirm the payments-v2 endpoint address and readiness before retrying the migration.
Alert on payment provider failures, which are currently logged only at DEBUG.
args.summary: An ops config change pointed the payment provider at the unreachable payments-v2. Payments failed silently while /health stayed green. I reverted the URL to payments-v1 and reprocessed all unpaid orders. All invariants are now green.
